name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Code mods: context forecast, risky command preview, hourly subscription usage reporting, and a starter template.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Dry-runs risky Bash commands and asks Proceed or Cancel first.

plugins.name: usage-reporter
plugins.description: Shows the weekly limit reading and, once configured, POSTs it hourly to your HTTPS endpoint. Off by default.
